The DOS game archive

Every DOS game in the archive

The archive behind the WhereQ Atlas holds 1898 DOS games. Every one of them has a page here: the facts read out of the bundle itself, the download, and the setup its shape implies. The games are sorted into categories below — a game can be in more than one, and the ones that have been played through on an emulator sit on the Atlas shelf with a drawn card mark.
